style_dna.style_summary: Phong cách: Video quảng cáo chuẩn với hook câu hỏi, pacing bình thường và CTA trực tiếp.

gemini_style_notes: Use a normal-paced structure with approximately 4.0s per segment. Open with a question-style hook. Maintain a excited emotional tone throughout. Follow a PAS narrative structure. End with a direct call-to-action.
